title: Keller-Segel-Navier-Stokes systems involving general sensitivities with Signal-Dependent Power-Law Decay
summary: This paper investigates a two-dimensional Keller--Segel--Navier--Stokes system with a tensor-valued chemotactic sensitivity $S(x,n,c)$. Under a signal-dependent power-decay condition $|S(x,n,c)| \le s_0 (s_1+c)^{-γ}$, we establish the global existence and uniform-in-time boundedness of classical solutions for both fluid-coupled ($γ> 1/2$) and fluid-free ($γ> 0$) systems.
